ctx.x: Yeah, Earl Swope for awhile, and then there was Carl Fantana later, and along with people like Urbie Herbie Green, we had later -- I'm trying to think of the fellow from New Orleans who was orginally with the Al Belletto group. Another marvelous trombonist, Jimmy -- I cannot think of his last name.
I can't either. I'll have to check that.
